responsibility: Declares the public range-folding interface for GIMPLE. It exposes fold_range entry points for statements on the current path, on a specific edge, or with caller-supplied operand ranges; defines helper predicates for range-supported statement and SSA forms; and declares the fur_source/fur_stmt/fur_depend abstractions plus fold_using_range, which are the main APIs for evaluating GIMPLE statements to value ranges.
same_name_distinction: Declares the range-folding API and abstractions such as fold_range, fur_source/fur_stmt/fur_depend, and fold_using_range that gcc/gimple-range-fold.cc implements. Unlike the .cc file, it defines the callable interface and helper inline predicates, not the folding algorithms themselves.
